caption: The drawing shows a single object composed of several wooden components that together form a rustic hand plow. The plow consists of three main pieces: a long horizontal beam extending to the left, a shorter vertical beam attached perpendicularly at the center, and a curved handle rising upwards and to the right. The main beam rests on a broad horizontal base with a narrow, pointed end directed to the lower left, resembling a plowshare. The wood is depicted in various shades of brown, with visible grain and texture, and the illustration is detailed to show joints and possible fastening elements. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, with no additional objects or scenery. At the lower right corner, there are small, hand-drawn inscriptions, including the name "Edith Towner" and "MARY N. WOODALL."
title: Plow
